text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Let's see—
The space I reserved is—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whuuuut are you doing here?!
I reserved this spot first!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Aren't you mistaken?!
The one who made the reservation was M-E!
And by the way, I'm winning the next race too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The hell did you say?!
Bring it on! Right here, right now, we'll settle once and for all who's――

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um――
If it's alright with you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
You can use... the space I reserved, too――
Would you like to... practice together?
Dancing together... might be nice, too.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! The salad that was supposed to cap off my day...
is down to the very last one?!

text_block_list.name: Salad-Seeking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm on a diet...
So I'm definitely not giving up Gran.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Does that mean you wanna race?
Awesome, awesome! Sounds like a blast!
Then how many miles should weââ

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like――please, have mine.
It's over on the other table.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you sure?
But then Bouquet-san won't have any...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Don't mind me—it should be restocked before long anyway.
Go ahead, after you.
...Today was just one of those days where I kept bumping into Curren Bouquetd'or wherever I went.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Good work today.
Fufu, we do run into each other often, don't we?

It seemed she had noticed it too.
So, I decided to share my thoughts on how she acted today.
choice_data_list: Are you not good with conflict?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, indeed. Conflict is truly—
If only I could protect—
everyone's peaceful time together...
Sharing spaces, passing around salad, and so on.
Trivial as it was, that habitual act not only averted unnecessary conflict, but also――
choice_data_list: I just thought it was really kind of you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ――I wonder... how is it? There are people who occasionally――tell me that, but... I haven't really――paid much attention to it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's just that—
I love 'harmony.'

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Just like how many flowers—
come together into a single, beautiful bouquet.
I... love peaceful moments, and peaceful spaces.
choice_data_list: Maybe that 'harmony' is what connects to your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Just like how many flowers—
come together into a single, beautiful bouquet.
I... love peaceful moments, and peaceful spaces.
choice_data_list: Maybe that 'harmony' is what connects to your kindness.

text_block_list.text:
Watching Curren Bouquetd'or's gentle demeanor makes it feel as though she embodies harmony itself.
When I tell her this――

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Y-You flatter me. I am not
such an extraordinary Umamusume.
...Though—thank you very much.
Curren Bouquetd'or smiled softly, like a blossoming flower.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Someone like you, Trainer, who can call others "kind"――
strikes me as a truly kind person as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
――Fufu.
This almost feels like... we're just trading compliments, doesn't it?
Growing self-conscious, both of us broke into shy smiles to cover up our embarrassment.
